{{Top|ga}} {{CelestialBody |image=[[File:Manaan-ZeroCompany.jpg]] |name=Manaan |region=*[[Inner Rim Territories]]{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Manaan system]] *[[The Slice]]{{SliceRegion|the [[Manaan system]], and therefore Manaan itself,|[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]}} |sector=None |system=[[Manaan system]] |coordinates=[[Standard Galactic Grid|O-11]] |xyz= |distance= |suns= |orbited= |position= |moons= |routes= |lengthday= |lengthyear= |class=Terrestrial{{Databank|manaan|Manaan}} |diameter= |atmosphere= |climate= |gravity= |terrain=[[Ocean]]s |water= |interest= |flora= |fauna=[[Glumbrig eel]]''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]'' |otherlife= |species=[[Selkath]] |otherspecies=[[Quarren]] |socialgroup= |language= |government= |population= |demonym= |cities=[[Ahto City]]''[[Star Wars Zero Company]]'' |imports= |exports= |affiliation= }} {{Quote|A flexible compass may not serve ye on the roiling waves of Manaan… but it does make the seas of the soul easier to brook, no?|Skoova Stev, speaking to Cal Kestis|audio=RoilingWavesOfManaan-JediSurvivor.flac|}} '''Manaan''' was an [[ocean]] [[planet]] located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Inner Rim Territories]]. It was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Selkath]], an aquatic [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that at one [[time]] was dedicated to the care of the world's oceans. Several criminal elements, including the [[Trandoshan]] [[Kranash]] and the [[Black Sun]] [[syndicate]], were involved in an [[Black Sun incident on Manaan|incident on Manaan]] that became widely known in the underworld by [[10 BBY]]. The [[fisher]] [[Skoova Stev]] crashed landed on Manaan after his [[Grapnel|starship]] hit a [[realspace|space]]-borne [[purrgil]] in [[orbit]] over the ocean world by [[9 BBY]]. Stev and his crewmates emerged from the wreckage on the sea floor. There, they encountered members of the [[Filthy Zephyrs]], a [[pirate]] group active on the planet. Stev managed to scare the pirates away after attempting to mimic the mating call of a [[glumbrig eel]] he saw passing by. ==Description== {{Quote|To me it looks like a…light intensifier?''"
"''Yeah, that’s what it is. I used some on a mission in the underwater caves of Manaan once.|Avon Starros and Dez Rydan, discussing using light intensifiers on Manaan|audio=LooksLikeALightIntensifier-IntoTheLight.flac|''[[The High Republic: Into the Light]]''}} Manaan was an [[ocean]] [[planet]] located in the [[Manaan system]] in the [[Inner Rim Territories]] and [[The Slice]], in grid square O-11 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. The terrestrial world's deep oceans were dark and included a number of [[Water|underwater]] [[cave]]s. The waters were also home to [[glumbrig eel]]s. ==History== ===Home of the Selkath=== {{Quote|Rawn was stationed with his master on Manaan before the Purge struck. If I retrace his steps, I may discover who else was meant to attend the meeting on Dantooine, and if any survived.|Tel-Rea Vokoss to Hawks|audio=TelRea-RawnOnManaan-ZeroCompany.flac|}} [[File:Mantu-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|right|250px|The Selkath (pictured) were the native species of Manaan.]] Manaan's [[homeworld|native]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]], the [[Selkath]], had ventured off-world by [[382 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates the events of ''The High Republic'' (2022) 6 to [[382 BBY]]. with at least one, [[Larti]], becoming a [[Jedi Master|Master]] with the [[Jedi Order]].[[The High Republic (2022) 6|''The High Republic'' (2022) 6]] The [[human]] [[Jedi]] [[Dez Rydan]] used a number of [[light intensifier]]s in Manaan's underwater caves during a [[Mission on Manaan|mission]] on the planet that had taken place by [[232 BBY]].''[[The High Republic: Into the Light]]'' establishes that [[Dez Rydan]] undertook his [[mission on Manaan]] prior to taking the [[Barash Vow]] during the [[mission on the Amaxine station]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[232 BBY]]. In [[228 BBY]],{{IntotheLightDate}} Ryden mentioned the mission to the [[scientist]] [[Avon Sunvale|Avon Starros]] while on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]][[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] planet [[Kashyyyk]] after Starros discovered a discarded light intensifier. Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Rawn Shonson]] and his [[Rawn Shonson's master|master]] were stationed at a [[Unidentified outpost (Manaan)|small outpost]] in [[Ahto City]] on Manaan during the [[Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy|galactic]] conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] from [[22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY]].''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' At the end of the war, the Republic was [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformed]] into a [[Galactic Empire]] and initiated [[Order 66]], which named all member of the Jedi Order as traitors to the Galactic Republic. Surviving the ensuing [[Great Jedi Purge|massacre]], Shonson used the alias "[[Arro Kontrera]]" while in Ahto City before eventually using it to travel to the planet''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' [[Boz Pity]]. Shonson was later [[Death|killed]] in an [[Ambush on Dantooine|ambush]] in [[18 BBY]]{{ZeroCompanyDate}} on the planet [[Dantooine]] by the [[Second Sister]], an [[Inquisitor]] tasked with hunting down surviving Jedi by the Galactic Empire.{{Databank|second-sister|Second Sister}} {{GameMechanics|Star Wars Zero Company}} After fellow surviving Padawan [[Tel-Rea Vokoss]] discovered Shonson's body she convinced her commander, the [[mercenary]] [[Tesh Keff Hawks|Hawks]], to allow her to retrace Shonson's steps on Manaan in hopes of finding other surviving members of the Jedi Order. Hawks assigned a team to investigate the outpost that Shonson and his master were stationed during the Clone Wars. While on Manaan, the team found the "Arro Kontrera" alias in the Ahto City transit logs including the last trip to Boz Pity. {{EndGame}} By [[10 BBY]],{{LRMDate|3}} the [[Trandoshan]] [[contract broker]] [[Kranash]] had been involved in an [[Black Sun incident on Manaan|incident]] on the planet that benefited [[Black Sun]] at the expense of other crime [[syndicate]]s. The human criminal [[Jaylen Vrax]] believed the incident should have earned Kranash a [[death mark]]. However, Kranash continued operating in the underworld despite his known involvement. While trying to negotiate an information exchange between himself and Kranash, Vrax referenced the job on Manaan in a failed attempt to flatter the Trandoshan.''[[Star Wars Outlaws: Low Red Moon]]'' ===Fisher down=== {{Quote|We were on our way tae Manaan tae sell the carcass of a gooberfish. But wham! Just as we dove out of hyperspace an' the great ocean world streaked into view…so did she. The most glorious creature I'd ever beheld. A whale of marvelous proportion - but swimmin' through Manaan's orbit like it was nothin' but an easterly current back home.|Skoova Stev, talking to Cal Kestis about his time on Manaan|audio=OnYourWayToManaan-JediSurvivor.flac|}} [[File:SkoovaStev-JS.png|thumb|right|250px|Skoova Stev (pictured) encountered a group of Quarren pirates on Manaan.]] By [[9 BBY]],{{JediSurvivorDate}} the [[Filthy Zephyrs]], a group of [[Quarren]] [[pirate]]s, had begun operating on Manaan. By the same [[Standard year|year]], the [[starship]] ''[[Grapnel]]'', [[captain]]ed by [[Wan'yek Whett]] and [[Unidentified fishing crew|crewed]] by a group of [[fisher]]folk, had traveled to Manaan to sell the carcass of a [[gooberfish]]. As the ''Grapnel'' exited [[hyperspace]] above the planet, it slammed into a [[realspace|space]]-borne [[purrgil]] creature, causing the ship to crash land on Manaan's sea floor. When the crew exited the crashed ship, they were surrounded by members of the Filthy Zephyrs, who demanded several things, including the [[fish]] stored aboard the ship. The crew attempted to flee but were soon surrounded yet again. One of the crew, a [[Sakavian]] named [[Skoova Stev]], noticed a nearby glumbrig [[eel]] and attempted to recreate their mating call to attract more of the eels. However, since he had neglected to turn on his [[environment suit]]'s external [[speaker]]s, no one could hear his call. The horrifying expression on Stev's face as he attempted to mimic the eel's call frightened the pirates away, allowing the crew to leave Manaan in the Filthy Zephyrs' ship. {{GameMechanics}} In 9 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], Stev met the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Cal Kestis]] on the planet [[Koboh]]. The pair quickly became friends{{Databank|skoova-stev|Skoova Stev}} and Stev shared the story of his ordeal on Manaan. Around the same [[time]], Stev used Manaan's roiling waves in an analogy about having a flexible moral compass. {{EndGame}} Manaan was mentioned in an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], which was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]]''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'' at some point no earlier than [[34 ABY]].{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}} ==Inhabitants== {{Quote|Uyoooooooiiii!|Skoova Stev reenacting the mating call of Manaan's glumbrig eels||audio=EelMatingCall-JS.flac}} Manaan was the homeworld of the aquatic Selkath species. Members of the species had two [[Limb|arms]] with three fingers on each. They also had two legs and were able to walk on land and leave their homeworld, though some wore armor equipped with misting vents to keep their skin moist when out of the water.{{Databank|chata-hyoki|Chata Hyoki}} Long before the Clone Wars, the Selkath were regarded as a peaceful species that was devoted to the care of their oceans.{{Databank|mantu|Mantu}} Selkath [[bounty hunter]]s [[Mantu]] and [[Chata Hyoki]] were both from Manaan but were active on planets [[Coruscant]] and [[Serenno]] respectively during the Clone Wars. A group of Quarren pirates called the Filthy Zephyrs had operated on the ocean world by 9 BBY. ==Locations== Ahto City was located on Manaan and had an small outpost used by Jedi during the Clone Wars. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Manaan.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Manaan as seen in the ''Star Wars'' Legends continity]] Manaan was first mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in Mantu's entry in the now-discontinued [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]] on [[StarWars.com]],{{SWE|characters|mantu|Mantu}} which was carried over to its replacement, the [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]]. In [[2016]], a ''Star Wars''-inspired compilation album titled ''[[Star Wars Headspace]]'' was released, and it featured a track named "Sunset Over Manaan," which was recorded by the house music producer [[ATTLAS]].{{SW|url=news/the-force-goes-electronic-announcing-star-wars-headspace-compilation-album|text=The Force Goes Electronic: Announcing ''Star Wars Headspace'' Compilation Album - Exclusive Cover Reveal}} Manaan first appeared as a [[hologram]] in the in the [[2026]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Zero Company]]'', developed by [[Bit Reactor]] and published by [[Electronic Arts]]. [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] was originally introduced in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a [[2003]] video game developed by [[BioWare]] and published by [[LucasArts]].''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Manaan}} *''[[The High Republic: Into the Light]]'' {{Ab|The High Republic: Into the Light (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} *''[[Star Wars Zero Company]]'' {{1st}} {{Hologram}} *''[[Star Wars Outlaws: Low Red Moon]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars Outlaws: Low Red Moon (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} *''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]'' {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SWE|characters|mantu|Mantu}} {{1stm}} *{{BuildFalconCite|23|Secrets of Spaceflight}} *{{SW|url=news/the-force-goes-electronic-announcing-star-wars-headspace-compilation-album|text=The Force Goes Electronic: Announcing ''Star Wars Headspace'' Compilation Album - Exclusive Cover Reveal}} {{C|In track name}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] {{MapPoint}} *''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Battle of Endor and the Fall of the Empire}} {{MapPoint}} *{{Databank|chata-hyoki|Chata Hyoki}} *{{Databank|manaan|Manaan}} *{{Databank|mantu|Mantu}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Manaan |fr=Manaan |pl=Manaan }} [[Category:Planets in the Inner Rim]] [[Category:Planets in the Slice]] [[Category:Waterworlds]] {{RelatedCategories |[[Category:Events on Manaan]] |[[Category:Manaan locations]] |[[Category:Organizations of Manaan]] }}
